messages.subject: Re: Can't seem to load data file.
parts:
Having seen this error message way too many times, I finally figured out that a "closure" is a function.  As a practical matter, it usually means you've forgotten to put parentheses after a function somewhere. In my case, it's almost always a reactive expression. So, for example, if you have:

x <- reactive (...)

when you want to use actually use x, you have say x()

Tom
